title: trumps maga inc gives 10 million to paxtons senate campaign ahead midterms 2026 09 05
text: NEW YORK, Sept 5 (Reuters) - President Donald Trump's MAGA Inc super PAC ​will spend at least $10 million on ‌the campaign of Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton for his U.S. Senate race ​against Democratic state Representative James ​Talarico, according to a Federal Election ⁠Commission filing on Saturday.
